name: 视频剪辑 OpenElf
description: Turn long footage into multiple publish-ready short clips: transcribe, find breath pauses, cut and re-encode, add subtitles and export in batch.
description_zh: 把长视频转成多条可独立发布的短片段：转写、找气口、裁剪重编码、生成字幕并批量导出。
description_en: Turn long footage into multiple standalone short clips: transcribe, detect breath pauses, cut and re-encode, add subtitles and export in batch, with unified aspect ratio and loudness.
examples_zh: 帮我读一下这段素材的时长和分辨率
把这条 3 分钟口播按气口切成 3 条短视频
给切好的片段烧上字幕并导出
examples_en: Read the duration and resolution of this footage
Cut this 3-minute talking head into 3 short clips by breath pauses
Burn subtitles into the clips and export them
